searchText: <@688748669268132001> we are at ~900K deposit count and only ~780K active+pending validators. What's the status of your PR, can we start pushing for it on ACD? can we start working on implementations for it? Do you refer to Add upper epoch churn limit #3448? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3448 If yes, PR is very simple as well as implementations. The bulk of the work is to get a strong signal of support Oh no, I feel that's a hack, I want the reuse of indices I feel like reuse of indices plus increasing maxEB will solve this problem completely reuse indices depends on maxEB, which we are working on it but there's still steep hills to climb <asn_d6> why does reuse indices depend on maxeb? I would have said exactly the opposite Technically they are independent. reuse indexes is useful when the ratio of active indexes to total records is *EDIT: low. MaxEB will cause such a situation. In the current mainnet state reuse indices won't clean up many records. Also note that in the current EIP records are not re-used after 1 year of withdrawable_epoch, so their effects will take a while to be noticed > MaxEB will cause such a situation I personally doubt this. I expect very few existing large stakers to consolidate validators. There's almost no benefit for them, and plenty of risk/cost/disruption. There were a bunch of withdrawals on Shapella, so reusing indexes will be useful very soon.

excerpts.author: benjaminion
excerpts.content:

I personally doubt this. I expect very few existing large stakers to consolidate validators. There's almost no benefit for them, and plenty of risk/cost/disruption.
